result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the two prior Story 7 blockers, the quick-fix touched surfaces, the real /lh-lower-band-status command path, the formerly flaky capture-service test path, and the configured story and epic gates. I did not perform a broad full-story rereview beyond convergence and touched-surface production-path audit.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Resolved by direct code and gate evidence. tests/context-steward/e2e-cli.e2e.test.ts now includes an E2E named `/lh-lower-band-status reaches the real operator command surface with truthful chunk readiness output` that invokes `runPi({ prompt: "/lh-lower-band-status", sessionFile })`, asserts the PI process exits cleanly, and asserts the source message count is unchanged after the slash command, proving the operator command surface handled the request rather than sending it as a model prompt. The same named E2E passed in the focused E2E run and again inside `npm run verify-all`.

Resolved by fresh repeat evidence. The previously flaky named test `production prompt projection does not reset when PI leaf advances during ordinary appends` passed in isolation, then passed inside a fresh `npm run verify`, and `npm run verify-all` also completed successfully. The quick-fix changed the test synchronization to observe token-counting metadata updates through a test-only tracking store rather than relying on the prior racy polling path.

verified: AC-5.1 / TC-5.1a / TC-5.1b: lower-band inspection reports ready, pending, failed, and blocker states from canonical chunk/readiness data
AC-5.2 / TC-5.2a / TC-5.2b: report output remains machine-readable and omits quality-eval/model-comparison scope
AC-5.3 / TC-5.3a / TC-5.3b: operator command wiring reaches WorkbenchQueryService lower-band inspection through the PI command surface
AC-5.4 / TC-5.4a / TC-5.4b: production-path reporting uses real lower-band state and does not bless placeholder lower-band text as semantic readiness
Definition of Done: narrow E2E proves the real operator command surface can reach lower-band inspection output
Story gate: npm run verify passed
Epic gate: npm run verify-all passed

gatesRun.command: node --import tsx --test --test-name-pattern "production prompt projection does not reset when PI leaf advances during ordinary appends" tests/context-steward/capture-service.test.ts

additionalObservations: The quick-fix synchronization helper `TokenCountingTrackingStore` is confined to tests and does not introduce a production fake, shim, or fallback path.
The Story 7 E2E now reaches `/lh-lower-band-status` through the PI operator command surface; the lower-band inspection formatter and WorkbenchQueryService remain the real production inspection path.
